artifacts.name: to-the-point
artifacts.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents. Invoke with /to-the-point or /direto-ao-ponto.

artifacts.name: factual-writer
artifacts.description: Mandatory voice for factual, concise prose. Zero adjectives, no em-dashes, no fluff, data precision, and peel-the-onion narrative. Supports write and review modes.

artifacts.name: communication-style
artifacts.description: Natural Brazilian Portuguese communication style: active voice, direct answers, and elimination of generic AI-filler phrases.

artifacts.name: technical-explanation-style
artifacts.description: Seven rules and two review passes (conceptual + mechanical) for explaining code to developers without repositories open.

artifacts.name: post-change-cleanup-review
artifacts.description: Structured post-modification review checklist targeting dead code, duplicate blocks, naming ambiguities, and test drift.

artifacts.name: post-change-tests-review
artifacts.description: Systematically assesses test relevance, duplicates, compatibility issues, and missing test scenarios following code edits.

artifacts.name: project-context-file
artifacts.description: Creates and maintains minimal AGENTS.md context files (<150 lines) adhering to the Toolchain First and Judgment Boundaries principles.

artifacts.name: taskforce
artifacts.description: Orchestrates an autonomous engineering task force (analyst, architect, implementer, reviewer, release-manager) with TDD and independent reviews.

artifacts.name: sync-skills
artifacts.description: Idempotent multi-platform symlink synchronization script for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.

artifacts.name: build-agents
artifacts.description: Synchronizes and compiles canonical subagents for Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Google Antigravity.

artifacts.name: validate-catalog
artifacts.description: Automated verification suite validating Agent Skills specification compliance, frontmatter format, and secret/DLP scan.

artifacts.name: sync-skills-ps1
artifacts.description: Windows PowerShell multi-platform synchronization script using symbolic links or junctions.

artifacts.name: build-agents-ps1
artifacts.description: Windows PowerShell tool synchronizing and compiling subagents for Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Google Antigravity.

artifacts.name: analyst
artifacts.description: Business analyst subagent: frames problems, gathers requirements, and produces decision documents.

artifacts.name: architect
artifacts.description: System architect subagent: decides layer placement, technical trade-offs, schemas, and prescriptive implementation plans.

artifacts.name: implementer
artifacts.description: TDD implementer subagent: writes production code and tests together, executes plans, and records trace logs.

artifacts.name: reviewer
artifacts.description: Read-only reviewer subagent: evaluates code and test quality independently across blocking, non-blocking, and nitpick severities.

artifacts.name: release-manager
artifacts.description: Release manager subagent: audits completed work, drafts pull requests, and publishes via GitHub CLI after explicit user approval.
